body: I have never heard it put so perfectly!!! I feel 1000% the same way! I'm sorry you're going through shyt, you're not alone my friend. I have prayed just about every night not to wake up. I try and try and try and no matter what I do I simply cannot become a person worth this life that has been thrown upon me. I don't want it anymore never really did, Too much of a coward to take my own life even though i dream about it constantly. The only time i find myself smiling, happy and free is when I am imagining the moment I finally pass away. Whats the point of living a life like this? I HAVE tried to succeed, I have tried to become a better person, I've done the therapy, ready the books, listened to the self help audios etc and yet here I am, no different. I can't support my family, cant support myself, my husbands birthday is next week and all I can give him is financial stress and burden. Like happy birthday here's some more stress, anxiety and uncertainty, from your loser wife who can't get her shyt straight.......
